title: Pull the two negative-OOS legs off alpaca_live
note: tlt_pullback_1h (-4.41R, n=94) and tlt_pullback_1d (-3.92R, n=8, 0 of 4 folds positive). One-line config change, reversible, does NOT wait on D1. TIER-3. APPROVED BY THE OPERATOR 2026-09-21 in conversation, verbatim: 'yeah, you can pull those strategies off if they need to be turned off.' Shipped as its own PR rather than inside the reset diff -- the one line that touches real money should not be reviewed inside a 360-file Tier-1 refactor. [!] THIS DOES NOT RETIRE THE QUESTION THE 1h LEG WAS ASKING. Its purpose was to prove real fills reconcile against exchange truth on a CASH book, and it never answered: ZERO long signals ever reached this account (18x Jun / 2x Jul / 13x Aug / 0x Sep, going quiet the day before the account was armed), and every package since 08-31 was SHORT, unexecutable here because the venue reads shorting_enabled: false. The alpaca_live order path is therefore STILL UNEXERCISED after this change. The three surviving legs inherit that job, and nothing yet checks that they do it -- if they also go quiet, the account is armed and proving nothing. [!] ROSTER-SYNC IS UNAFFECTED and this was verified, not assumed: the invariant is a SUBSET assertion (test_alpaca_portfolio_mirrors_alpaca_live_minus_proxies), so shrinking the live roster can never break it. Both legs stay in alpaca_portfolio, where their paper record keeps accruing. [!] MEASURED WHILE SHIPPING THIS, and it is the sharper version of the asymmetry finding: scripts/check_dry_run_in_diff.py reports 'dry_run_in_diff: clean' on THIS diff. Removing a leg from a roster is NOT guarded -- only the literal mode:/execution: fields are. Two spellings of 'off', one guarded. B1 must key on ROSTER MEMBERSHIP. [!] MERGED 2026-09-21 as 47404b4 (PR #12673), CI green. STATE IS `landed_unproven` AND NOT `done`, deliberately: merged is not observed. The trader reads config on its next reload, so the live roster has NOT been confirmed to read 3 legs. Closing this row means reading alpaca_live's roster off /api/bot/config on the running trader -- not re-reading the YAML, which is the file we just changed and therefore proves nothing about the process. OBSERVED 2026-09-25T13:29Z on the RUNNING PROCESS (not the YAML): both GET /api/bot/config and GET /api/bot/runtime-config (process_state: observed, boot 2026-09-25T13:22:19Z) show alpaca_live.strategies = exactly [ief_pullback_1d, slv_pullback_1d, iaum_pullback_1d] -- 3 legs, neither tlt_pullback_1h nor tlt_pullback_1d present. This satisfies the row's stated close condition (roster read off the running trader). Note only -- this is a Tier-3 row and no state change is proposed here; the operator/manager should make that call.
